lookback_summary: What a weekend it was in the Premier League! The model had a mixed bag of results but managed some impressive calls. It correctly predicted the draw between Fulham and Man United, and nailed the home win for Man City against Sunderland. However, I had to eat humble pie on the Leeds vs Crystal Palace match, as the model's call for a home win was way off there. It also faltered with the Everton and Brighton games, while on the flip side, it correctly saw Liverpool and Coventry City taking away victories. Newcastle's edge as a banker proved spot on too, so not all was lost!
